Maya Reed sends message asking to move cardboard consumables box to loading bay.
Prototype confirmed present in LAB on brown table (grey box with black triangle).
Nora Vale (teal coat) enters EAST_CORRIDOR. Person in teal coat seen in East Corridor camera.
Maya Reed (purple coat) seen at LOADING BAY carrying a cardboard box.
Theo Park (blue coat) enters CAFETERIA. Person in blue coat seen in Cafeteria camera.
Ada Finch (red coat) enters RECEPTION. Person in red coat seen in Reception camera.
Nora Vale (teal coat) exits EAST_EXIT carrying the prototype (grey box with black triangle).
Prototype discovered missing from LAB. Only the brown table remains.

gaps_and_assumptions.description: No camera footage or access logs for the LAB interior between 18:00 and 18:18. The prototype could have been removed at any point in this interval, but Nora's presence in the adjacent East Corridor at 18:10 makes her the primary suspect.
The Service Corridor is a blind spot (V10). No one is logged entering or exiting it, but it provides an unmonitored path to the Lab.
